name: mvp-3d-map
description: A Google/Amap-style 3D city map with client-side turn-by-turn navigation. Renders pre-baked HD map data (osm2streets lane geometry, lane markings, turn arrows, detailed 3D buildings) with MapLibre + three.js, plus a routing graph and A* running entirely in the browser. Includes the offline baking pipeline (osm2streets + osmium + tippecanoe) to regenerate the vector tiles.
